angrypenguin1000: Viktor Angrypenguin arrived at R-C3 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.
darian_d_16: Day 9: Silas "Mole" Darian reached S-R10 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
gefocheh2050: Edmund "Rabbit" Gefocheh signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-C15 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
kowalien: Severin Kowalien came up on Day 8 carrying news from Ashford Vale. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
Severin Kowalien got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.
kwintenlulay_: Yann Kwintenlulay joined the replacements on Day 5. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name. The transfer made Yann Kwintenlulay a stretcher bearer. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

Yann Kwintenlulay cut Gideon "Whistle" Vylet's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short. A letter from home found Yann Kwintenlulay before the night shift. Yann Kwintenlulay folded it small and kept it close. After the loss of Hill 304, Yann Kwintenlulay helped stack spare sandbags at R-S9. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Yann Kwintenlulay measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together. A letter from home found Yann Kwintenlulay before the night shift. Yann Kwintenlulay folded it small and kept it close.

Someone asked Yann Kwintenlulay to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten. A letter from home found Yann Kwintenlulay before the night shift. Yann Kwintenlulay folded it small and kept it close.

Yann Kwintenlulay counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool. A letter from home found Yann Kwintenlulay before the night shift. Yann Kwintenlulay folded it small and kept it close.
A recruit asked Yann Kwintenlulay how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label.
moitpan: Day 9. The corporal put Tobias "Smokes" Moitpan beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
moregano_1: Day 9: Nils "Ghost" Moregano reached R-R4 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
pavla.9_: Karel Pavla found a place in R-F10 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
Volunteer number 68. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Karel Pavla's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'
Orders came through: Karel Pavla is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a tin whistle.
A bullet clipped Karel Pavla's helmet at R-F10 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Karel Pavla is whole again, or near enough for the line. Victory at Verdel Ridge. Karel Pavla let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Karel Pavla and Albin "Tin" Shoes compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.

Karel Pavla pulled Oskar Eddie out of a flooded shell hole at the Sunken Road. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember. A letter from home found Karel Pavla before the night shift. Karel Pavla folded it small and kept it close.

Karel Pavla went out with the wiring party at R-F10. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into R-F10. Karel Pavla has learned to walk bent double.

Karel Pavla fired at a movement across the wire at R-F10. The man went down: Bram Ahmadhcj, badly wounded. A letter from home found Karel Pavla before the night shift. Karel Pavla folded it small and kept it close.

A bullet went through Karel Pavla's sleeve at R-F10 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Marek Ditrih of the Hegemony (@ditrih_88). A clear shot from R-F10. Karel Pavla gravely wounded Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso and slid back down below the parapet.

The medic cut the last bandage off Karel Pavla's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to R-F10 the same hour. A letter from home found Karel Pavla before the night shift. Karel Pavla folded it small and kept it close.

Karel Pavla had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Pavel "Crow" Hayden was badly wounded. A letter from home found Karel Pavla before the night shift. Karel Pavla folded it small and kept it close.
seal.ingfan: Jakub "Brick" Ingfan arrived on Day 3 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.

A clear shot from R-F19. Jakub "Brick" Ingfan grazed Felix Landon and slid back down below the parapet. The transfer made Jakub "Brick" Ingfan a machine gunner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

The dugout roof dripped into Jakub "Brick" Ingfan's mug. He moved the mug. The roof found another way. A letter from home found Jakub "Brick" Ingfan before the night shift. Jakub "Brick" Ingfan folded it small and kept it close.

Jakub "Brick" Ingfan found water collecting beneath the gun's cover. He sketched a small shelter and took the drawing to the stores. A letter from home found Jakub "Brick" Ingfan before the night shift. Jakub "Brick" Ingfan folded it small and kept it close. News that the Hegemony had taken Hill 304 reached Jakub "Brick" Ingfan during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

A sniper's bullet hit Jakub "Brick" Ingfan at R-F19. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss of the Concord (@eddholmesss). A bed came free in the hospital dugout, and Jakub "Brick" Ingfan was carried in at last. Jakub "Brick" Ingfan is out of danger. Still bedridden, still bandaged, but out of danger. A letter from home found Jakub "Brick" Ingfan before the night shift. Jakub "Brick" Ingfan folded it small and kept it close.
The medics would not give up on Jakub "Brick" Ingfan. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to R-F19 today.

Across from R-F19, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Jakub "Brick" Ingfan saw it. Teodor Deanc was grazed. A letter from home found Jakub "Brick" Ingfan before the night shift. Jakub "Brick" Ingfan folded it small and kept it close.

Jakub "Brick" Ingfan did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Jakub "Brick" Ingfan fired back. Felix Landon was grazed. A letter from home found Jakub "Brick" Ingfan before the night shift. Jakub "Brick" Ingfan folded it small and kept it close.
superfeisty7: On the way to R-F9, Rafael "Button" Superfeisty tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
One of the first hundred, Rafael "Button" Superfeisty was given the First Wave ribbon. He wrapped the accompanying paper against the damp.
Rafael "Button" Superfeisty and Isidor Glc made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it with frozen hands.

A section of parapet collapsed near Rafael "Button" Superfeisty. The repairs began as soon as the dust settled, with one man watching while the others worked. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord at dusk. Rafael "Button" Superfeisty helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Rafael "Button" Superfeisty fixed the strap on Pavel Mvuisak's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac held the mirror while Rafael "Button" Superfeisty shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.

The bread was divided with a ruler. Rafael "Button" Superfeisty received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler. After the loss of Hill 304, Rafael "Button" Superfeisty helped stack spare sandbags at R-F9. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Rafael "Button" Superfeisty began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.

A sniper's bullet hit Rafael "Button" Superfeisty at R-F9. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Roland "Ash" Hud of the Hegemony (@hay_ant_hud). A clear shot from R-F9. Rafael "Button" Superfeisty grazed Pavel "Crow" Hayden and slid back down below the parapet. Rafael "Button" Superfeisty was killed outright at R-F9, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Roland "Ash" Hud of the Hegemony (@hay_ant_hud).

Ivo "Ash" Superfeisty asked about Rafael "Button" Superfeisty on arriving at R-F9. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another. Ivo "Ash" Superfeisty is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.

A bullet went into Ivo "Ash" Superfeisty's chest just under the heart at R-F9. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Felix Zulfi of the Hegemony (@rayan.zulfi). Ivo "Ash" Superfeisty saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at R-F9 and fired once. Jakub You was grazed. Ivo "Ash" Superfeisty was hit at R-F9 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Felix Zulfi of the Hegemony (@rayan.zulfi).

The papers connected Wendel Superfeisty to Ivo "Ash" Superfeisty. The men took longer to learn Wendel Superfeisty's own habits, but they made the effort. Wendel Superfeisty was among the first hundred through the depot gates. The First Wave ribbon is the only clean thing he owns.

Wendel Superfeisty was hit in the forearm at R-F9. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Roland "Ash" Hud of the Hegemony (@hay_ant_hud).
